A few things about Heirloom that might help you feel more confident:

We grow our own roses at our nurseries in Oregon; we don’t buy from third-party growers.
All of our roses are premium own-root plants grown in 1-gallon containers with soil, not grafted or bare root. They tend to be longer-lived and more resilient over time.
Every rose comes with our one-year guarantee, and our garden advisors review any concerns one-on-one.
We’re not trying to just “sell you something”; the goal is to match you with plants that will actually thrive in your conditions.
